categories_thin: Real estate brokerage: only two small independent offices (James Realty, PC McRealty) plus one property manager; most South River-facing brokerages are franchise offices (RE/MAX Exceptional, Coldwell Banker, eXp) or sit in East Brunswick on Route 18.
Physical therapy: only one in-town clinic (Create Your Core); the other PT clinics near South River are in Milltown or on Route 18 in East Brunswick.
Orthodontists and medical specialists: none located in South River - the orthodontists serving the town are on Riva Ave or Route 18 outside the borough.
Accounting/tax: five practices found; several are one-person CPA offices at shared addresses, so additional sole practitioners may exist without a Maps listing.

Property management, title/appraisal, staffing, surveying: thin - one appraiser, no title agency and no surveyor with a South River office; the only staffing office identified is a franchise (Express Employment Professionals) and was excluded.
Fitness: no independent gym in town; only martial-arts schools and a yoga studio.
caveats: The zone coordinates in the brief (40.4498,-74.4407) sit near Milltown, about 2.8 miles west of South River town centre (40.4465,-74.3860). Everything listed is inside the South River borough boundary, which is well within 10 miles of that point.

Addresses in the 500-700 block of Old Bridge Turnpike sit on the borough's northwest edge next to East Brunswick; their South River location was checked against the OSM borough boundary rather than trusted from the listing.

67 W Prospect St and 23 W Prospect St appeared as nearby chiropractor/dentist addresses but West Prospect Street there is in East Brunswick, so Corrective Care Group and Brunswick Family Dental were excluded.

Excluded under the rules: RE/MAX Exceptional (52 Main St) and other franchise-branded offices; Frank G. Milo Agency (Nationwide-branded, 183 Hillside Ave); Express Employment Professionals (8 Old Bridge Tpke, franchise); Family Financial Centers (60 Main St, check-cashing franchise).
Several salon, barber and spa entries come only from bulk directories (BestProsInTown, Birdeye) and have no phone number; the triage team should confirm them before outreach.

Where two names share one address (706 Old Bridge Tpke, 704 Old Bridge Tpke, 60 Ferry St, 295 Main St, 43 Main St, 74 Main St, 153 Whitehead Ave) they may be separate suites in one building or a renamed business; each is kept separately with a note.
data_gaps: YellowPages.com, AllPages, WhereOrg, Cybo and MapQuest all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks from this network, so those directories were only usable through search-result snippets.
The Borough of South River's own business directory page (southrivernj.org/businessdirectoryii.aspx) returned no usable results when read; no municipal licensed-business list was obtainable.
No local chamber of commerce directory for South River was found; the town appears to rely on a county/regional chamber with no public South River-specific listing page.
Overpass API was not attempted beyond Nominatim, which was reachable and used for boundary and address verification.
Many listings showed no phone number or website unless each map place panel was opened individually; those fields are marked Unknown rather than guessed.
